sn34.4:1.5: One meditator is skilled in positivity for immersion but not in immersion.
sn34.4:1.6: One meditator is skilled neither in immersion nor in positivity for immersion.
sn34.4:1.7: One meditator is skilled both in immersion and in positivity for immersion.
sn34.4:1.8: Of these, the meditator skilled both in immersion and in positivity for immersion is the foremost, best, leading, highest, and finest of the four.
